CreateProfileDialog.title: New profile
CreateProfileDialog.description: Each profile has its own projects, activities and time entries.

UnavailableProfileDialog.title: Profile unavailable
UnavailableProfileDialog.text: The profile file could not be found or is not a valid Taktra profile. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.
UnavailableProfileDialog.newerVersionText: This profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra and cannot be opened by this version. Update Taktra to use it again. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.

WelcomeView.title: Welcome to Taktra
WelcomeView.text: Create a profile to start tracking your time, or open an existing profile file.
WelcomeView.missingText: The file of the selected profile could not be found or opened. Create a new profile, open a profile file, or remove the profile from the list.
WelcomeView.newerVersionText: The selected profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra. Update Taktra, choose another profile, or remove it from the list.

TrackingView.title: Tracking
TrackingView.placeholder: Time entries of the selected day

ProjectsView.title: Projects
ProjectsView.deleteConfirmText: The project is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

ProfileGeneralSettings.nameDescription: Stored in the profile file. Renaming does not change the file name.

DeleteProfileSection.title: Delete profile
DeleteProfileSection.description: Moves the profile file to the trash and removes the profile from Taktra.
DeleteProfileSection.confirmText: The profile file will be moved to the trash. You can restore it from there as long as the trash has not been emptied.
